            ok: true;

            acknowledged: number;
        }>;

            includePayloads?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<ActivityRunDetail>;
        activityRuns: (opts?: {
            before?: number;
            job?: string;
            limit?: number;
            origin?: ActivitySpanOrigin;
            session?: string;
            status?: string;
        }) => Promise<{
            history: ActivityRunSummary[];
            live: ActivityRunSummary[];
        }>;
        activityStats: (days?: number) => Promise<ActivityRuntimeStats>;
        authMethods: () => Promise<{
            passkey: boolean;
            password: boolean;
        }>;
        brainAdd: (content: string, opts?: {
            tags?: string[];
            title?: string;

            path?: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;

            content: string;
        }>;
        brainIndex: () => Promise<{
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        brainSearch: (q: string, opts?: {
            limit?: number;

            tag?: string;
            type?: string;
        }) => Promise<BrainSearchResponse>;

        brainStatsHistory: () => Promise<CorpusStatsHistory>;

            message: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        fileResolve: (path: string) => Promise<{
            ancestors: string[];
            exists: boolean;
            path: string;
            type?: "dir" | "file";
        }>;
        geoCoastline: (bbox: [number, number, number, number], opts?: {
            signal?: AbortSignal;
            width?: number;
        }) => Promise<CoastlineGeometry>;
        health: () => Promise<{
            status: string;
            timestamp: string;
            uptime: number;
        }>;
        login: (password: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        logout: () => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        models: () => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        moduleAction: (name: string, id: string) => Promise<unknown>;
        moduleMigrationApply: (name: string, revision: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleMigrationPreview: (name: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsMigrationPreview>;

        moduleSettingsPreview: (name: string, values: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleSettingsSave: (name: string, values: Record<string, unknown>, revision: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleState: (name: string, state: "active" | "dormant") => Promise<{

        }>;

        }>;

        }>;

        }>;

        }>;

        passkeyRegisterVerify: (response: RegistrationResponseJSON, label?: string) => Promise<{

            timeZone: null | string;
        }>;

        sessions: () => Promise<{

        setThinkingOverrides: (thinking: Record<string, ThinkingLevel>) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;

        }) => Promise<WebSearchConfig>;

    export function useBrainApi(): {
        activityDigest: (clientId?: string) => Promise<{

            acknowledged: number;
        }>;
        activityRollups: (days?: number) => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivityRollups>;
        activityRun: (runId: string, opts?: {
            includePayloads?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivityRunDetail>;
        activityRuns: (opts?: {
            before?: number;
            job?: string;
            limit?: number;
            origin?: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivitySpanOrigin;
            session?: string;
            status?: string;
        }) => Promise<{
            history: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivityRunSummary[];
            live: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivityRunSummary[];
        }>;
        activityStats: (days?: number) => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ActivityRuntimeStats>;
        authMethods: () => Promise<{
            passkey: boolean;
            password: boolean;
        }>;
        brainAdd: (content: string, opts?: {
            tags?: string[];
            title?: string;
            type?: string;
        }) => Promise<{
            indexError?: string;
            indexed?: boolean;
            path?: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        brainBriefing: () => Promise<{
            content: string;
        }>;
        brainIndex: () => Promise<{
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        brainSearch: (q: string, opts?: {
            limit?: number;
            mode?: "fts" | "hybrid" | "vector";
            signal?: AbortSignal;
            tag?: string;
            type?: string;
        }) => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").BrainSearchResponse>;
        brainStats: () => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").CorpusStats>;
        brainStatsHistory: () => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").CorpusStatsHistory>;
        brainSync: () => Promise<{
            message: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        fileResolve: (path: string) => Promise<{
            ancestors: string[];
            exists: boolean;
            path: string;
            type?: "dir" | "file";
        }>;
        geoCoastline: (bbox: [number, number, number, number], opts?: {
            signal?: AbortSignal;
            width?: number;
        }) => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").CoastlineGeometry>;
        health: () => Promise<{
            status: string;
            timestamp: string;
            uptime: number;
        }>;
        login: (password: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        logout: () => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        models: () => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ModelCatalogResponse>;
        moduleAction: (name: string, id: string) => Promise<unknown>;
        moduleMigrationApply: (name: string, revision: string) => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
